The **Audio** group of the node palette has 5 nodes: 4 run, 1 cannot run yet or is deprecated.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Audio Augmentation](../audio/audio-augmentation.md) | Can't run yet | Configure training-time waveform augmentation before feature extraction. |
| [Audio Input](../audio/audio-input.md) | Runs | Expose waveform and label batches from the loaded project audio dataset. |
| [Mel Spectrogram](../audio/mel-spectrogram.md) | Runs | Mel spectrogram. |
| [MFCC](../audio/mfcc.md) | Runs | Extract MFCCs. |
| [Spectrogram](../audio/spectrogram.md) | Runs | Compute spectrogram. |
